baseline.method: OLS on controls whose labels matured before each UTC day (out-of-sample); added value = test minus reference residuals

comparison.rationale: unreplenished liquidity hypothesised to precede continuation toward the depleted side

question: After a displayed-depth shock, do slow refills precede larger moves in the depleted side's direction than fast refills?
